panels.title: Traffic by Country (remote end)
panels.description: Bytes exchanged with each country, by the country of the remote (public) end of each flow; marker size is the byte count. A flow between two public addresses counts toward its responder. Country from a local GeoIP database (IP geolocation by DB-IP, db-ip.com), written as tags by the collector: flows recorded before it had the database are not counted. Private and other non-public addresses are never a country. The base map is the country outline file Grafana itself ships (public/maps/countries.geojson), so nothing on this panel is fetched from the internet.

panels.title: Top Countries (remote end)
panels.description: The 15 countries most bytes were exchanged with, by the country of the remote (public) end of each flow. Country from a local GeoIP database (IP geolocation by DB-IP, db-ip.com), written as tags by the collector: flows recorded before it had the database are not counted. Private and other non-public addresses are never a country.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Which tzsp-monitor instance these panels read. Remote sites are the REMOTE_SITE_* lines in properties.yml of the instance serving this Grafana; each is a datasource pointed at that site's own InfluxDB, so nothing is copied between sites. Controls never follow this box: rule suppression and reverse DNS only ever act on the local site, and are inert while another site is selected.

list.name: cidr
list.label: CIDR filter
list.description: Restrict every panel to traffic with either endpoint in this range, e.g. 10.12.0.0/16, 10.12.6.0/24, or a bare IP. Leave empty for no filter. Prefix lengths other than /8, /16, /24 and /32 round down to the enclosing octet boundary, so /20 behaves as /16 and may show a wider range than typed.

list.name: top_talkers
list.label: Top talkers (internal)
list.description: Hidden helper: the top-10 source IPs, fed to the reverse-DNS resolver.
